description: This Java class 'StackTraceExpander' processes logcat output lines to expand collapsed Java stack traces, particularly handling '... N more' lines by restoring full stack frames from enclosing exceptions. It maintains internal state to parse and expand stack traces for better log readability.

classes.name: StackTraceExpander
classes.description: A class that parses logcat lines to expand Java stack traces, handling '... N more' lines by restoring full frames from outer exceptions.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Processes a single logcat line, updating internal stack trace state, and expanding '... N more' lines with actual stack frames.

methods.name: isStackFrame
methods.description: Checks if a line matches the pattern of a Java stack frame line.

methods.name: getElidedFrameCount
methods.description: Extracts the number of frames elided in a '... N more' line.

methods.name: isCauseLine
methods.description: Checks if a line indicates a 'Caused by:' line in a stack trace.
